versionPairs.description: An all-lazy Bun app (Bun 1.3.14, `bun build --target=bun --format=cjs`, unminified): the bun-plain app with ALL six modules reached only through require() from a CommonJS loader and a two-statement entry — the shape the module markers describe (Claude Code's). The markers cover >99% of the app code: the split keeps the marker method, each lazy module one file. The only real-build fixture on the marker method since the method is chosen from the bundle's contents. Generated by ../bun-apps. v1.1.0 changes the palette and archive reports and adds a function to the CommonJS dep.
